neighbours.label: ' way' in the idiom 'lead/led the way'
fire: Women from the village led the way in building the new school.
Our engineers have always led the way in battery design.
In the nineteenth century, France led the way in photography.
She hopes the city will lead the way on clean transport.
Small farms are leading the way toward organic methods.
Scouts led the way through the forest to the lake.
The younger players led the way with three goals each.
Denmark has long led the way in wind energy.
quiet: Women from the village helped in building the new school.
Our engineers have always cared about battery design.
In the nineteenth century, France was famous in photography.
She hopes the city will find a way to cut traffic.
Small farms are moving slowly toward organic methods.
Scouts walked a long way through the forest to the lake.
The younger players led the team with three goals each.
Denmark has long invested heavily in wind energy.

notes: Card: ' way' x16, almost all 'led the way'.
